hypothesis: The consolidated note (30 Sep 2026, section 24.5) asks to 'report at least' the domain-length DISTRIBUTION among the physical statistics; E34 reported only its mean and median. E37 compares the whole distribution of coarse domain lengths (N-31's observable: runs shorter than one kink width merged) between exact samples and samples from the learned kernels.
design: The 24 (cell, seed) pairs of E34's physics_learned (six cells, seeds 0-3, M = 2048), the same frozen E33 fits (risk-selected; hpc_E33k_s0 for mixture, Legendre, spline, MDN; hpc_E33q_s0 for the site energy) and the SAME random streams as E34 (rng tags e34-learned-truth / e34-learned / e34-learned-jit), so the samples are E34's own: 2048 chains per arm, ancestral on the grid from each kernel's invariant law. Per (cell, seed, arm): the interior coarse domain lengths in physical units, their 10/50/90% quantiles, the two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance to the truth's, and histogram counts on common bins. Failed fits (E33 amendment 3) are failed rows. Laptop, 4 workers.

predeclared_predictions.P1: Samples from the spline and from the site energy reproduce the distribution: on every cell the seed means of their 10%, 50% and 90% quantiles are within 10% of the truth's, and the seed-mean KS distance to the truth is below 0.05.
predeclared_predictions.P2: The mixture's domain-length distribution is too short where the wells are deep: on the three T = 0.3 cells its seed-mean KS distance exceeds 0.05 and its 90% quantile is more than 15% below the truth's.

outcome.P1: FALSIFIED AS WRITTEN, by a miscalibrated threshold. Quantiles: spline and site energy within 10% of the truth's q10, q50, q90 on every cell except the spline's q10 at h = 0.5 (1.104; one lattice step of 0.5 on a q10 of about 5). KS below 0.05 on the four cells with T <= 0.5, but not at T = 1 (site energy 0.053) and T = 2 (spline 0.065, site energy 0.073). Those cells have only ~675 and ~350 domains per sample, and the KS between two INDEPENDENT EXACT samples of the same size is 0.036 (max 0.060) at T = 1 and 0.057 (max 0.080) at T = 2 (unregistered calibration, 4 replicate pairs per cell): the 0.05 band sat below the sampling noise. The seed-mean two-sample KS p-value of the spline and site-energy rows is 0.36-0.88 on every (cell, arm); the 48 individual tests range from 0.033 to 1.00, and 2 of them fall below 0.05 (site energy, T = 1 seed 0: 0.033; T = 2 seed 1: 0.048), close to the 2.4 expected by chance at that level. Reading: their domain-length distributions are statistically indistinguishable from exact sampling on every cell.
outcome.P2: FALSIFIED AS WRITTEN on its second clause. The mixture's KS distance exceeds 0.05 on all three T = 0.3 cells (0.079-0.085, four to five times the exact-vs-exact 0.017-0.019), but its q90 is 12-13% below the truth's (0.874-0.885), not more than 15%; its MEDIAN is 14-18% short (0.82-0.86). The direction is right, the size of the tail deficit was overstated.
outcome.unregistered: MDN (quantiles within 6%) and Legendre where it fitted (within 9%; q10 1.083 at h = 0.5) reproduce the distribution with KS inside the exact-vs-exact range. Away from the deep wells the mixture is close too: at T = 0.5 and T = 2 its KS is inside the exact-vs-exact range (0.021, 0.069), at T = 1 marginally above it (0.062 against a reference maximum of 0.060). Its clear failure is confined to the T = 0.3 cells, where the linear drift cannot hold a domain.
